compute_obb_losses: compute oriented bounding box losses including centerness, classification, 3D IoU, bbox, and chamfer loss components
compute_occ_losses: compute occupancy and total variation losses for 3D voxel grid predictions against point cloud data
get_gt_obbs: get ground truth oriented bounding boxes from a batch with optional time union and voxel grid filtering
obbs_to_7d: convert oriented bounding boxes to 7D representation with center, dimensions, and gravity-aligned yaw angle
iou_3d_loss: compute weighted 3D rotated IoU loss between predicted and ground truth oriented bounding boxes
